n: Café 27.8 Cu. Ft. Smart 4-door French-door Refrigerator
desc: Get the ultimate refrigeration solution with the Cafe ENERGY STAR 27.8 Cu. Ft. Smart 4-Door French-Door Refrigerator. With its 27.8 cu. ft. capacity and Free-Standing French Door design, this refrigerator provides ample storage space for all your favorite foods and beverages.
hl: Use the slim, full-width freezer compartment for flatbread, pizzas and other uniquely shaped frozen items, which is part of a three-level, freezer storage system of sliding shelves and trays
A superior surface that reflects your style
Keep your refrigerator looking clean and chic with a fingerprint-resistant exterior that lets you wipe away smudges with ease

Keep this refrigerator drawer sparkling at all times, thanks to a gray liner you can easily remove to clean up spills and messes.
